notes:
I created one probe script, run once, at /Users/miguel/.julia/dev/Redstone.jl/design/reports/20261124_doc_conformance/probes/L8a_v/probe.jl. Every judgment and line number is from the worktree pinned at 72b12836. I edited no tracked file and committed nothing.

Results: 10 claims conform and 20 are drift. There is no deviation, defect or gap, so no judgment carries a backing_entry. Every drift is recorded by a later log entry, an annotation already on the cited entry, or a commit:
- L8a-045: commit 69451bc7 retired sketch_io.jl.
- L8a-046: commit 1d295a07 removed condition_demo.jl.

Two gaps in the existing annotations:
- D-146 has no annotation pointing to D-177. D-177 moved binding-side detection from method presence to the is_input/is_output traits.
- D-187's annotations already cover L8a-095 and L8a-098.

Under log_rules.md rules 1-2, each drift fix would land as an annotation, never as a rewrite of the Position.

One edge case on L8a-001, judged conforming: children are read from each field's value (`value isa AbstractComponent`), not its declared type. A field declared `::Any` that holds a component still becomes a child. Spec §8.5 says "fields whose type is <: AbstractComponent", which could be read as the declared type. This is worth a look if a strict reading is wanted.
